mapper.select: SELECT id, category, question_text AS questionText, page_route AS pageRoute, weight, sort_order AS sortOrder, hit_count AS hitCount FROM quick_questions WHERE status = 'enabled' AND (page_route = #{pageRoute} OR page_route IS NULL) ORDER BY FIELD(category, 'manual_curated', 'auto_extracted', 'ai_suggested'), weight DESC, sort_order ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ql.question_text AS questionText, ql.question_hash AS questionHash, ql.page_route AS pageRoute, COUNT(*) AS frequency, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(ql.response_rating, 1)), 2) AS avgRating, LEAST(ROUND((COUNT(*) / GREATEST((SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM question_logs WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowDays} DAY) GROUP BY question_hash ) AS sub)), 1) * 0.7 + COALESCE(AVG(ql.response_rating), 1) * 0.3, 2), 1.00) AS aiConfidence, MAX(ql.created_at) AS lastAskedAt, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 20 THEN '丰富' WHEN COUNT(*) >= 10 THEN '中等' ELSE '基础' END AS infoLevel FROM question_logs ql WHERE ql.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowDays} DAY) AND ql.answered = 1 AND LENGTH(ql.question_text) >= 5 GROUP BY ql.question_hash, ql.question_text, ql.page_route HAVING frequency >= #{minFrequency} ORDER BY frequency DESC, avgRating DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE quick_questions SET hit_count = hit_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
